data.name: Mashawir
data.gender_notes: Mashawir is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Sh-W-R' meaning 'to illuminate, shine, or be luminous'. In Islamic contexts, the name Mashawir refers to one who brings light, guidance, and wisdom. The name Mashawir carries the meaning “Illuminate, Shine” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mashawir usually hope their child will grow to embody illuminate, shine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and guidance.
data.etymology: Mashawir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Illuminate, Shine.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mashawir total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مشاور
in_arabic.long_meaning: يسعد الله تعالى مساهمته في المشاورات العزيزة، ويقويه على التفكير في الأمور البعيدة، ويجعله من المشاركين في النقاشات الحسنة، ويجعله من المشاركين في الأعمال الجيدة. مشاور في الأصل يشير إلى الشخص الذي يُساعد في التخير، ويُشير إلى الشخص الذي يُساعد في اتخاذ القرارات. ويُعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تعكس القيم الدينية الإسلامية مثل المساعدة، والتكافل، والتعاون.

This name also highlights the essential role of spiritual illumination in personal growth and development, and in helping others on their own spiritual journeys.
